notes.title: Step Into the Illusion — Possessions Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3][i]Sometimes, the way we see the world is the puzzle itself.[/i][/h3][p]
[i]Possessions[/i] invites you to slow down and look again — at shapes, at shadows, at shifting perspectives. It’s a puzzle game built around quiet moments of discovery, with no words to tell you what to do, only a world that gently unfolds when you change your point of view. [/p][p]The demo, now live on Steam for Windows, macOS, and Linux as part of [b]Steam Next Fest 2025[/b], offers a glimpse into this meditative experience:[/p][list][*][p]Twist reality and solve chaos in the first chapter of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock silent stories without a single line of dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Immerse yourself in a minimalist space designed for calm and curiosity.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve poured our hearts into making a game that rewards patience and invites reflection. Now, we’re eager for you to play, explore, and share what you see. [/p][p][/p][h3]Play the Demo Now:[/h3][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3408400"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h3]Join the Conversation:[/h3][p]We value your feedback immensely. After playing, please share your thoughts and experiences in the discussion forum. Your insights help us improve and shape the future of [i]Possessions.[/i][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3384920/discussions/0/" style="button"]Community Hub Forum[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Wishlisting helps us a ton, so if you haven’t already, hit that button now![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384920/Possessions/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Thank you for stepping into our world. We can’t wait to hear what you discover.[/b][/p]

notes.title: The Story Behind Possessions—Live from Comic Con x IGU
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're thrilled to share that [i][b]Possessions[/b][/i] was recently featured at Indie Game Utsav—India's largest celebration of homegrown indie games at Comic Con India!

Among 100+ titles, [i][b]Possessions[/b][/i] stood out for its unique take on spatial puzzles and perspective-based gameplay. If you’re into relaxing but clever games that challenge how you see the world, this one’s worth a closer look. Check out some of the coolest games from India in the special [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/comicconxindiegameutsav] Indie Game Utsav Steam Sale![/url]

To mark the occasion, we’re sharing a special Steam broadcast featuring:
[list]
[*] A [b]behind-the-scenes[/b] developer interview with Chirag Chopra (Game Director) discussing the design philosophy and evolution of Possessions.
[*] A [b]live AMA session[/b] from the event covering player questions, development insights, and what’s next for the game.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384920/Possessions

Thanks to everyone who visited us at Comic Con—and to those discovering the game for the first time here on Steam, [b][i]welcome.[/i][/b]
